programmes.d: A manhunt ensues after a homemade bomb explodes in New York's Chelsea neighbourhood, injuring 30 people.
A serial killer stalking Yosemite National Park is caught by an FBI profiler who reveals the murderer's darkest inner secrets.
The FBI launches an international investigation to track down the armed attackers who stormed the U.S. Special Mission in Benghazi, Libya, killing the US Ambassador and three other Americans.
The FBI's Hostage Rescue Team heads to the remote wilderness of Idaho to track down a kidnapper and the16-year-old girl he abducted.
An ATF raid on the compound of an armed religious group in Waco, Texas, goes wrong, leaving four federal agents dead and more than a dozen wounded. The FBI must find a way to end the deadly standoff.
The longest siege in US history ends in bloodshed, leaving a record of anger and controversy that still burns today.
A pair of hard-charging FBI agents deploy to Boston, hoping to bring and end to the15-year-long hunt for a to- ten fugitive - notorious mobster Whitey Bulger.
For three weeks in October 2002, citizens of the Washington, D.C area are terrorized by an unknown sniper who seems to choose his victims at random.
The FBI Hostage Rescue team must rescue a five-year-old boy from an armed killer holding him hostage in an explosive-filled bunker.
Time is running out for the FBI agents who are determined to rescue a five-year-old boy from an armed killer holding him hostage in an explosive-filled bunker.

When two bombs cut a swathe of death and destruction through the crowd of runners and spectators at the finish line of the Boston Marathon, the FBI must work frantically to find the bombers before they can strike again.
With Boston in lockdown after the bombing at the city's famous marathon, an epic gun battle erupts between police and the two men who are soon revealed to be the bombers.
When gang warfare overwhelms a small town, FBI agent James Gagliano hatches a plan to dismantle the rival gangs in one day.
When an outlaw biker gang brings drugs and violence to Taunton, Massachusetts, it's time for the FBI to step in. Will the undercover agents make the big bust or will their cover get blown?

When an armed bank robber terrorizes the Boston area, the FBI's Bank Robbery Task Force springs into action. Can law enforcement catch up to the Southside Bandit before someone gets seriously hurt or worse?
The FBI investigates two New York police officers who are suspected of commiting murders for the mafia.
A devastating explosion rips through the heart of downtown Oklahoma City, forcing FBI investigators to conduct a rescue mission while searching for clues about the murderer.
After Timothy McVeigh is discovered to be responsible for the bombing of a Federal Building in Oklahoma, the FBI learns his hope is to instigate a civil war in America.
A woman accuses her ex-husband of murdering their baby. Is it a tale of a woman scorned, or the chilling story of a cold-blooded child killer?
When the charred remains of a wealthy Las Vegas real estate developer are discovered, suspicion falls on the least likely of suspects--his sweet, gentle wife who doesn't look anything like a killer.
Two men on trial for killing an elderly man claim the old man got what he deserved. They tell the court that he had abused his family for decades.
The tragic story of 18-year-old Hannah Hill of Akron, Ohio, whose murder may never be solved.
The shocking story of Kathy Bush, regarded as a caring mother and a national advocate for health care, who was suddenly arrested for child abuse.
A look at how the justice system handled the unique case of Dr. L. Stan Naramore, who was convicted of attempting to murder a 78-year-old terminally ill woman.
Christine's and Heidi's trip on a Greek ferry becomes a nightmare when the boat begins to sink and the crew abandons the ship.
Lonnie plays dead for four agonizing hours after her boyfriend chokes her and shoots her four times in the head.

In 1849, a man suddenly disappeared in Bermondsey. The discovery that he had been brutally murdered enraptured the press and the public. Even Charles Dickens was totally engrossed in the story of the sinister Marie Manning.
At the time of Jack The Ripper, London was home to some of the most terrible individuals the city has ever seen. One of the very worst was the elusive Borough Poisoner, George Chapman.
Having killed his wife and buried her in the basement, Dr Crippen believed he had escaped on a ship to Canada. But the police managed to hunt him down and bring him to account for his terrible crime.
George Smith had many aliases. He needed them for his many wives who he would soon murder in order to claim the inheritance. Catching this chameleon would be a gargantuan challenge.
Edith Thompson and Frederick Bywaters were in love. But the young couple were convicted for murdering her husband in a case that shocked society and fascinated Alfred Hitchcoc
It was WWII and London was rocked by the Blitz from the planes flying above. But down on the streets below another terrible danger lurked in the shadows. A serial killer was on the loose.
As Europe recovered from the damage of WWII, soldiers made their way home from the front line. But one man, brought back all the savagery and brutality of the fighting.
John Christie brought death to everyone around him. He managed to pin his terrible crimes on another man who would be sentenced to death. He eluded capture for years.
